title: Ring doorbell bundle £39.99, Kindle Paperwhite Signature £139.99 and Ninja Crispi £99
description: Amazon's Black Friday Week starts today: Ring doorbell and camera £39.99, Paperwhite Signature £139.99, Ninja Crispi £99, Oral-B iO3 £49.99.
intro:
**Amazon's Black Friday Week starts today and runs to Cyber Monday, 30 November.** The pick for today is a Ring Battery Video Doorbell with a Ring Indoor Camera for £39.99, and the Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition is holding at its low of £139.99. In the kitchen, the Ninja Crispi glass air fryer is £99 and the Ninja StaySharp knife block is £109.99. For grooming, the Oral-B iO Series 3 is £49.99 and the Philips OneBlade 360 is £39.99.

All of today's prices were reported at Amazon on 18 November, as the early deals rolled into the main sale, so check the product page before you buy. Buy now or wait? The Ring bundle, Paperwhite Signature and Fire TV Stick 4K Max are already at or near their best prices. The knife block has been about £10 cheaper before, so it's fine to wait on that one.

deals.name: Ring Battery Video Doorbell + Ring Indoor Camera bundle
deals.note: A wire-free video doorbell plus an indoor camera for about what the doorbell alone cost last Black Friday. The 'was' price adds both list prices together. You'll want a Ring Home plan to save and replay clips. More in our [Ring doorbell Black Friday guide](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Amazon Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition (2024), 32GB
deals.note: The Paperwhite with auto-adjusting light, wireless charging and no ads. £139.99 is the lowest we've seen, and it's cheaper than the standard Paperwhite. Our [Kindle vs Kindle Paperwhite guide](/guides/kindle-vs-kindle-paperwhite/) explains which to buy.

deals.name: Ninja Crispi portable glass air fryer
deals.note: A compact air fryer that cooks in glass containers you can serve from and store in the fridge. Good for one or two people or a small kitchen. Bigger families should compare models in our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Ninja Foodi StaySharp Knife Block (5 knives with built-in sharpener)
deals.note: A knife block with a sharpener built into the slot, so the blades stay keen. Which? price data shows it went to about £99 last November, so this is a decent price rather than a record. Wait a few days if you can.

deals.name: De'Longhi Magnifica Evo Next bean-to-cup coffee machine
deals.note: Grinds fresh beans and makes espresso, cappuccino and lattes at the press of a button. Beans work out far cheaper than pods if you drink a few cups a day. Compare it in our [coffee machine Black Friday guide](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Oral-B iO Series 3 electric toothbrush
deals.note: The cheapest way into Oral-B's iO range, with its quieter magnetic motor and a pressure sensor. Ignore the £175 'was' price, which it rarely sells at; around £50 is still a good price. See our [Oral-B Black Friday guide](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Philips OneBlade 360
deals.note: Trims, edges and shaves with one flexible blade, and it's gentle on sensitive skin. A useful stocking filler for anyone who keeps stubble rather than a full beard.

deals.name: Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Max (newest model)
deals.note: The fastest Fire TV Stick, with Wi-Fi 6E and a quicker menu than the cheaper sticks. If you just need 4K streaming, the Fire TV Stick 4K Select is £21.99. Our [Fire TV Stick deals guide](/guides/fire-tv-stick-deals-uk/) compares them.

deals.name: LEGO Star Wars Advent Calendar 2026
deals.note: 24 days of mini builds and minifigures, about £7 under its usual price with less than two weeks to go. More choices in our [Lego advent calendar 2026 guide](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/).

body:
## Worth waiting for?

Amazon's main sale starts today and runs for 12 days, so some prices could still move before Black Friday on 27 November. Amazon's own devices (Kindle, Ring, Fire TV) are usually at their lowest from the first day, so there's little to gain by waiting on those. Many of Amazon's best prices don't need Prime, but members get extra deals and free fast delivery. If you're not a member, today is a good day to start a [30-day Prime free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime), so it covers Black Friday, Cyber Monday and Christmas orders. Our [Amazon Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/) has the dates and tips.

For every retailer's sale dates, see [when is Black Friday 2026](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/).

## This week: Black Friday kitchen deals

The Crispi, StaySharp knife block and De'Longhi coffee machine are all in this week's spotlight category. Our [Black Friday kitchen deals 2026 spotlight](/spotlight/black-friday-kitchen-deals-2026/) shows what to buy now, what to wait for and the prices worth paying.
